$comment: Generated by `yidam schema`. Regenerate rather than edit. A schema file without this line is the repository's own, and `yidam schema` refuses to overwrite it.
description: The YAML frontmatter of a source in .yidam/catalog/. Describes where knowledge came from, not the knowledge itself.

artifacts.description: Optional. What this entry has actually obtained, by content address. This is what makes `obtained: true` demonstrable rather than asserted — the digest names the bytes. The bytes themselves live in a vault; the repository keeps the record.

from.description: An index into this entry's `location` list, or a literal URL for bytes obtained from somewhere it does not list.

readings.description: Derived readings of these bytes (RFC-0048 §6): a PDF's text, a source pack's extract. Each names its own digest, its media type, and what took it.

by.description: `<crate> <version>` for an extractor; `<pack>@<version>/<transform>@sha256:<hash>` for a pack's transform.

redistributable.description: Whether these bytes may leave this machine at all. A licensing fact about the source, which overrides `vault` — a route is edited casually and a licence is not something that edit may undo.

resource.description: Which of the resources at `from` these bytes are, when that origin serves more than one: the query an API was asked, the file a download page listed. A new digest is a new version only of a record with the same origin and resource.

retrieved.description: YYYY-MM-DD. When these bytes were obtained — distinct from the entry's own `retrieved:`, which is about the record.

sha256.description: 64 lowercase hex characters. Lowercase because hex is case-insensitive and a content-addressed store is not — two spellings would be two keys for one artifact.

text.description: A text reading as entries before #1318 recorded it. Read still; `catalog-extract` now writes `readings:`.

vault.description: Which store these bytes may be kept in. `none` means the local cache and nowhere else, and is spelled rather than omitted so that "nobody has decided" and "decided to keep it here" are different states.

commit.description: Optional, on a `file` location. The commit the file was read at, in full (40 hex digits); `value` is then a path from the repository's top level. RFC-0051.

repo.description: Optional, with `commit`. A dependency name in `.yidam/tonpa.toml`; absent means this repository.

symbol.description: Optional, with `commit`. A `::`- or `.`-separated path whose last segment must occur as a word in the file at `commit`.

obtained.description: Absent means yes. `false` declares a source registered ahead of the extraction that will use it — which exempts it from catalog-uncited and makes citing it an error.
